question: Is 'day' or 'night' a designation that the game itself can have, going back and forth once it has started?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the game starts as neither, and once it becomes day or night it is exactly one of them from then on.
expected.answer: Day and night are designations that the game itself can have. The game starts as neither. Once the game becomes day (or less commonly, night), the game will be exactly one of them—day or night—going back and forth for the rest of the game.
